game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the hold guard must hold off frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Then check potions and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from frost imps in Ice Market: keep potions above zero until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 2, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
